{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Define population: exclude QA and refunded orders
population_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)
filtered_df = df[population_mask]

# Check that we have both channels
print(f"Channels in filtered data: {filtered_df['channel'].unique()}")

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
segment_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f"Customer segment distribution by channel:\n{segment_by_channel}")

# Check if segments are balanced
print(f"Segment balance between channels:\n{segment_by_channel.apply(lambda x: x.max() - x.min(), axis=1)}")"}
